name: Non-disclosure agreement
description: The terms that decide whether an NDA is acceptable: who is bound, for how long, and what is carved out.

fields.name: Parties
fields.description: The disclosing and receiving parties as named in the preamble

fields.name: Effective date
fields.description: The date the agreement takes effect

fields.name: Mutual or one-way
fields.description: Whether both parties disclose (mutual) or only one

fields.name: Purpose
fields.description: The stated purpose for which confidential information may be used

fields.name: Confidentiality term
fields.description: How long the confidentiality obligations last after disclosure or termination

fields.name: Agreement term
fields.description: How long the agreement itself runs

fields.name: Standard exclusions
fields.description: Are the usual carve-outs present (public domain, already known, independently developed, third-party source)?

fields.name: Compelled disclosure
fields.description: May information be disclosed when required by law or court order, with notice?

fields.name: Residuals clause
fields.description: May the recipient use information retained in unaided memory?

fields.name: Return or destruction
fields.description: What must happen to the information on request or termination

fields.name: Governing law
fields.description: The state or country whose law governs

fields.name: Injunctive relief
fields.description: Does the agreement acknowledge that equitable relief is available for breach?

name: Master services agreement
description: Commercial, risk and exit terms of a services agreement.

fields.name: Parties
fields.description: The customer and the provider as named in the preamble

fields.name: Effective date
fields.description: The date the agreement takes effect

fields.name: Initial term
fields.description: The length of the initial term

fields.name: Auto-renewal
fields.description: Does the agreement renew automatically?

fields.name: Termination for convenience notice
fields.description: Notice required to terminate without cause, and by whom

fields.name: Payment terms
fields.description: When invoices are due, e.g. net 30, and any late-payment interest

fields.name: Liability cap
fields.description: The cap on each party's aggregate liability (amount or formula, e.g. fees paid in the prior 12 months)

fields.name: Liability cap exclusions
fields.description: What is carved out of the cap (confidentiality, indemnities, gross negligence, IP)

fields.name: Indemnities
fields.description: Who indemnifies whom, and for what (IP infringement, third-party claims, data breach)

fields.name: Service levels
fields.description: Any uptime or response commitments and the remedy for missing them

fields.name: IP ownership
fields.description: Who owns deliverables and work product

fields.name: Governing law
fields.description: The state or country whose law governs

name: Commercial lease
description: The economic and control terms of a commercial lease.

fields.name: Landlord
fields.description: The landlord as named in the lease

fields.name: Tenant
fields.description: The tenant as named in the lease

fields.name: Premises
fields.description: The address and area of the leased premises

fields.name: Commencement date
fields.description: The date the term begins

fields.name: Lease term
fields.description: The length of the initial term

fields.name: Base rent
fields.description: The base rent and the period it is stated for (per month or per year)

fields.name: Rent escalation
fields.description: How and when base rent increases (fixed percentage, CPI, stepped)

fields.name: Security deposit
fields.description: The security deposit amount

fields.name: Renewal options
fields.description: Any option to renew, its length and the notice required

fields.name: Permitted use
fields.description: The use the premises may be put to

fields.name: Assignment and subletting
fields.description: Whether assignment or subletting is permitted and on what consent

fields.name: Repair and maintenance
fields.description: Which party is responsible for repairs, structure, HVAC and common areas

name: Employment agreement
description: Compensation, restrictive covenants and exit terms of an employment agreement.

fields.name: Employee
fields.description: The employee's name

fields.name: Employer
fields.description: The employing entity

fields.name: Position
fields.description: The title or role

fields.name: Start date
fields.description: The employment start date

fields.name: Base salary
fields.description: The base salary and its period

fields.name: Bonus
fields.description: Any bonus, its target and the conditions for earning it

fields.name: Equity
fields.description: Any equity grant, its size and vesting schedule

fields.name: Non-compete
fields.description: The length of any post-employment non-compete, and its scope

fields.name: Non-solicit
fields.description: The length of any non-solicitation of employees or customers

fields.name: Termination notice
fields.description: Notice required to terminate, by either side

fields.name: Severance
fields.description: Severance payable on termination without cause, and any conditions (release, good reason)

fields.name: Governing law
fields.description: The state or country whose law governs
